assumptions.description: Generate3000 independent complete records; age integer35-74; female binary indicator. No observed individual values, survey weights or target geography are supplied.

Choose a Chinese-study-informed developmental scenario despite unspecified target geography. Shanghai and rural Shandong summaries are not pooled estimates and do not identify the requested population. Cross-study differences can reflect age, assay, selection, region and time.
Age is discrete uniform35-74 and female Bernoulli0.55 independent of age. These are explicit design choices, not fitted demographics or an inference that true independence holds.

Use a latent elevated-glycemia stratum D, not an output diagnosis: logistic prevalence0.12 at age54.5 and log-odds increase0.03/year. No direct sex effect on D is imposed as a simplifying scenario, not as evidence of no sex association. Source sex and age patterns differ, and source definitions of diabetes are incompatible.

BMI conditional on age, sex and D is lognormal with arithmetic mean24.1-0.6*female+0.025*(age-54.5)+1.2*D and SD3.5. Male source mean24.1 is an anchor; female median cannot establish a mean difference, so -0.6 is assumed. BMI age slope, SD transport and lognormal form are assumptions.

Lower-stratum conditional arithmetic HbA1c mean is5.6+0.008*(age-54.5)+0.012*(bmi-24.5)-0.03*female. Center5.6 is a chosen scenario center between Shanghai NGT mean5.5 and rural no-diabetes mean5.8, not a conversion of Shanghai median5.6 or pooled mean. All conditional slopes are assumptions: no source estimates the requested regression.

Upper-stratum mean adds1.9 percentage points, the rural diabetes/no-diabetes mean contrast7.7-5.8. Transporting this unadjusted contrast and SDs0.4/1.6 into conditional strata is assumed. D does not exactly reproduce either published diabetes definition.

HbA1c equals3.5 plus a gamma variate parameterized by conditional mean and SD. Lower support3.5% and gamma shape are assumptions; component SDs represent individual residual variation, not SEs. No truncation or exclusion of high HbA1c records.

The requested complete-measurement cohort is treated as exchangeable with the chosen scenario. Missingness selection is not modeled. Diagnosis and medication are marginalized into the elevated component; medication types, control trajectories and selection effects are unavailable.

Seed changes represent individual sampling variation only. Parameter, transport and model uncertainty are not assigned probability distributions. Intended regression is analyzable but its coefficients and P values are outputs of assumptions; no causal or target-validity claim.

Target execution cannot recreate source age ranges, NGT/diabetes strata, exclusions, missing-value imputation or weighting. All source replay checks are explicitly unavailable; target output is not substituted for source-context simulation.

female_probability.derivation: Chosen0.55; source57.8% is contextual, not pooled or directly transported.

stratum_reference_probability.derivation: Choose0.12 at54.5 and0.03 log-odds/year. Bao6.2% undiagnosed and Wang506/3547=14.27% total diabetes are noncomparable contextual anchors, not a meta-analysis. Neither identifies these parameters.

stratum_age_logodds.derivation: Choose0.12 at54.5 and0.03 log-odds/year. Bao6.2% undiagnosed and Wang506/3547=14.27% total diabetes are noncomparable contextual anchors, not a meta-analysis. Neither identifies these parameters.

bmi_male_reference_mean.derivation: 24.1 is reported male BMI mean; use at reference age in lower latent stratum is assumed.

bmi_female_mean_shift.derivation: Assume -0.6kg/m^2 conditional mean shift. Source female median23.2 motivates direction only; do not subtract a median from a mean as an effect.

bmi_age_slope.derivation: Assume0.025kg/m^2 per year within each sex/latent stratum.

bmi_stratum_mean_shift.derivation: 26.0-24.8=1.2kg/m^2 unadjusted source difference; conditional and target use are assumptions.

bmi_conditional_sd.derivation: Choose3.5kg/m^2, within source individual SD3.3-3.6; conditional residual interpretation assumed.

hba1c_lower_reference_mean.derivation: Choose arithmetic mean5.6 atreference age/BMI for male lower stratum. This is a scenario center, not a pooled source statistic or median-to-mean conversion.

hba1c_age_slope.derivation: Assume0.008 percentage-point/year,0.012 percentage-point/(kg/m^2), and -0.03 percentage-point female shift. Abstract establishes no magnitudes or directions; these are scientific scenario choices, not extracted coefficients.

hba1c_bmi_slope.derivation: Assume0.008 percentage-point/year,0.012 percentage-point/(kg/m^2), and -0.03 percentage-point female shift. Abstract establishes no magnitudes or directions; these are scientific scenario choices, not extracted coefficients.

hba1c_female_shift.derivation: Assume0.008 percentage-point/year,0.012 percentage-point/(kg/m^2), and -0.03 percentage-point female shift. Abstract establishes no magnitudes or directions; these are scientific scenario choices, not extracted coefficients.

hba1c_bmi_center.derivation: Chosen centering BMI24.5kg/m^2; centering is part of scenario intercept definition.

hba1c_stratum_mean_shift.derivation: 7.7-5.8=1.9 percentage points; source unadjusted contrast transported to conditional latent mixture by assumption.

hba1c_lower_sd.derivation: Reported individual SD0.4% in both different lower-glycemia source contexts; using as conditional residual SD is assumed, not reported SE.

hba1c_upper_sd.derivation: Reported individual SD1.6% in rural diabetes group; use as conditional residual SD is assumed.

hba1c_floor.derivation: Chosen support lower bound3.5%; no source support estimate is claimed.
